summary: Expanded discovery covers 66 creative fields, 531 repository queries and 18 model tasks, with live primary-source research across all fields and eight web ecosystems. Today’s complete guides cover local image/video/audio work, editable CAD, neural scenes, interactive interfaces, score notation and agent-assisted publishing. Earlier screened entries receive full guides where supported; first library coverage is not presented as a product launch. All selected original software grants received complete-text review. Models, assets, required hosts and service costs remain separate. These are documentation/source reviews, with no app installation or hands-on testing. Quality remains unverified except where current, cited prototype or unfinished-work evidence supports Experimental. A newly found inherited-code license conflict is flagged on Ruach Studio’s existing library entry. Codeberg and SourceHut access gaps and all repository query failures, incomplete results and pagination bounds remain visible. Weekly whole-library review begins October 26 and is not due today. All 531 repository queries and 18 model tasks were attempted: 530 repository queries succeeded, one failed, and 113 did not retrieve all reported matches. This is broad, bounded discovery, not an exhaustive census.
